capabilities: Render vault folder structure as a fixed radial tree
Cluster dense folders into single cluster nodes
Filter, highlight, dim, or hide nodes by name
Save and re-apply display and physics configurations
Project estimated future files per folder on a timeline slider
disambiguation: Not a link-graph tool; it maps folder and file placement only and ignores wikilinks, backlinks, and frontmatter.
extras: Some UI strings and settings labels are written in Korean only (e.g. "위그드라실 고정 트리 열기"). Large vaults of several thousand notes may be slow to lay out on first open.
problem: Obsidian's default Graph View shows wikilink relationships, so users who want to see how notes and folders are organized by location have no folder-structure visualization.

relations.evidence: Install Obsidian42 - BRAT, then add this repository as a beta plugin.

summary: Read-only graph view that renders the vault's folder structure as a bottom-rooted trunk-and-branches tree instead of a wikilink force graph.
